pr_body:
Create the necessary task instances for a mapped task at dagrun.verify_integrity

Fixes https://github.com/apache/airflow/issues/22561
pr_comments: The failing tests are due to mapped task flow not getting mapped kwargs(Looks related to https://github.com/apache/airflow/pull/22683)

The PR most likely needs to run full matrix of tests because it modifies parts of the core of Airflow. However, committers might decide to merge it quickly and take the risk. If they don't merge it quickly - please rebase it to the latest main at your convenience, or amend the last commit of the PR, and push it with --force-with-lease.
There are some inherited eyesores in `verify_integrity` we could improve later but this should be good as-is.
